name: 5-CT
summary: 5-Carboxamidotryptamine (5-CT), also known as 5-(aminocarbonyl)tryptamine, is a tryptamine derivative closely related to the neurotransmitter serotonin.

pharmacology.text: 5-Carboxamidotryptamine (5-CT), also known as 5-(aminocarbonyl)tryptamine, is a tryptamine derivative closely related to the neurotransmitter serotonin. 5-CT acts as a non-selective, high-affinity full agonist at the 5-HT1A, 5-HT1B, 5-HT1D, 5-HT5A, and 5-HT7 receptors, as well as an agonist of the 5-HT2, 5-HT3, 5-HT6 receptors with lower affinity. It has negligible affinity for the 5-HT1E and 5-HT1F receptors.

uses.text: Structural study indicated residue Ser5x43 might play critical roles in the selectivity of 5-CT across the serotonin receptor family.

summaryZh: 5-氨甲醯基色胺是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C11H13N3O，為色胺衍生物，可作為多種5-羥色胺受體的激動劑。
summaryZhHans: 5-氨甲酰基色胺是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C11H13N3O，为色胺衍生物，可作为多种5-羟色胺受体的激动剂。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. It is a laboratory tool rather than a drug people take. In animals it lowers body temperature and affects blood vessels, as would be expected from its strong action on serotonin receptors.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它是實驗室工具，而不是供人使用的藥物。在動物身上，它會降低體溫並影響血管，這與它對血清素受體的強烈作用相符。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它是实验室工具，而不是供人使用的药物。在动物身上，它会降低体温并影响血管，这与它对血清素受体的强烈作用相符。

fact.en: It is serotonin with its hydroxy group replaced by an amide, and it binds very tightly to several serotonin receptors. That makes it a standard reference compound in laboratories studying those receptors.
fact.zh: 它是把血清素的羥基換成醯胺基，能與多種血清素受體緊密結合。因此它成為研究這些受體的實驗室中的標準參考化合物。
fact.zhHans: 它是把血清素的羟基换成酰胺基，能与多种血清素受体紧密结合。因此它成为研究这些受体的实验室中的标准参考化合物。
